summary: Whole Foods Market, Blue Circle, and BioMar announced a collaboration to launch cleaner and more sustainable farmed salmon products. The initiative represents an effort by the three organizations to improve environmental and sustainability standards in aquaculture production and retail distribution of salmon products globally recognised for higher sustainability practice standards in their respective markets in the United States and Europe.
title: Whole Foods Market, Blue Circle og BioMar lanserer renere og mer bærekraftig oppdrettslaks
